title: Topological Phenomena Protected by Diabolical Textures
summary: We present a new class of topological phenomena in inhomogeneous systems arising from the adiabatic spatial embedding of parametrized families of quantum states such as charge pumps and their generalizations. We demonstrate that each topologically distinct class of these ``diabolical textures" gives rise to distinct gapped states that are separated by ``trap-scaling" critical points, defect transitions, or intervening phases.
